meta.source: Yahoo Finance v8 chart, daily bars (adjusted closes for stocks and funds)
meta.method: Joint OLS with the market as a control and all of the market's factors together; HC1 robust standard errors. stock % = a + bMarket·market % + Σ b_k·factor_k. Daily (2y) for all factors except USD/INR: weekly non-overlapping ISO-week returns (5y). Market response: market % = a + Σ c_k·factor_k. Total effect = b + bMarket·c.
meta.alignment: US: same date. India daily: previous US session for oil, gold, dollar index, US 10Y and VIX; same day for USD/INR and the Nifty. Weekly: same ISO week.
meta.reliableRule: n >= 250, |t| >= 2.5 (HC1), same sign in both halves of the window; |t| >= 3 when the graph has no business link
meta.keepRule: a link reliable at the previous refresh stays reliable at |t| >= 2 with both halves and the overall sign unchanged
meta.chance: Permutation test (5 shuffles of factor rows against stock rows, same rule): average false passes
